Kerzmann v. Burleigh County Social Services

Annotate this Case


Filed June 30, 2005COURT OF APPEALSSTATE OF NORTH DAKOTA2005 ND App 7
Corinne Kerzmann, Petitioner and Appellantv.Burleigh County Social Services, Respondent and Appellee
No. 20050076CA
Appeal from the District Court of Burleigh County, South Central Judicial District, the Honorable Bruce B. Haskell, Judge.AFFIRMED.Per Curiam.Kent M. Morrow, Severin, Ringsak & Morrow, P.O. Box 2155, Bismarck, N.D. 58502-2155, for petitioner and appellant.Gary R. Thune, Pearce & Durick, P.O. Box 400, Bismarck, N.D. 58502-0400, for respondent and appellee.
Kerzmann v. Burleigh County Social Services20050076CA
Per Curiam.
[¶1] Corinne Kerzmann appealed from an order of the district court dismissing her attempted appeal from the decision of an administrative law judge affirming her termination as an employee with Burleigh County Social Services, on the ground the district court did not have subject-matter jurisdiction because Kerzmann failed to properly perfect her appeal under N.D.C.C. § 28-32-42.
[¶2] The order dismissing the appeal is affirmed under N.D.R.App.P. 35.1(a)(7), in accordance with the controlling dispositive appellate decisions of DuPaul v. North Dakota Dep't of Transp., 2003 ND 201, ¶¶ 6-10, 672 N.W.2d 680 and Benson v. Workforce Safety & Ins., 2003 ND 193, ¶¶ 5-7, 672 N.W.2d 640.
[¶3]Bruce Bohlman, S.J.Everett Nels Olson, S.J.Norman J. Backes, S.J.
